title: Draft Advocates (Amendment) Bill, 2026 Released for Stakeholder and Public Consultation
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Law and Justice

Draft Advocates (Amendment) Bill, 2026 Released for Stakeholder and Public Consultation

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
20 JUL 2026 5:38PM by PIB Delhi

A Draft of Advocates (Amendment) Bill, 2026 as prepared, in consultation with the Bar Council of India (BCI), has been placed by the BCI for stakeholder consultation.

The Bar Council of India has hosted the Draft Advocates (Amendment) Bill, 2026 on its official website on 18th July, 2026 for inviting comments and suggestions from all stakeholders. The draft Bill may be accessed at
https://www.barcouncilofindia.org/home.

All stakeholders and members of the public are requested to submit their comments/suggestions, if any, on the draft Bill to the Bar Council of India on or before 31st July, 2026 (03:00 PM) at
draftadvact2026bill[at]gmail[dot]com
 and at
lmpcell-dla[at]nic[dot]in
.

The inputs received during the consultation process will be examined. The Department remains committed to a transparent, participative and consultative legislative process in line with the evolving needs of the legal profession and to achieve the goals of Viksit Bharat @2047.

****

Pranab/ Sagar

(रिलीज़ आईडी: 2286679)
